# Your Trusted Source for Security, AV and Smart Living Solutions

ADI is a leading distributor and solution provider of security, AV, and smart living products
serving over 100,000 customers worldwide. We offer access to a broad portfolio of products,
including top-tier distributed brands and our own exclusive brands.

With more than three decades of industry experience, we're committed to building long-lasting
customer relationships - making us a preferred partner for professionals across the industry.

# Our Mission

### We aim to provide products, services and software that help keep our communities safe, secure,
### comfortable and connected.

## Here's How We Do It

### Access to Exclusive Brands

We take pride in our exclusive, in-house manufactured products and software solutions, delivering
smart solutions that combine quality and innovation. From home automation to commercial-grade
infrastructure, we craft technologies that focus on what customers value most – delivering a
reliable and exceptional experience

[Access to Exclusive Brands]
[Support and Services]

### Support and Services

We offer a wide range of support and services to provide expert guidance at every step - from design
and configuration to ongoing support. With OvrC Remote Management, customers can easily manage,
configure, and troubleshoot devices across the network. OvrC is available on a range of exclusive
brand products and integrates with many leading distributed brands. Additional offerings include
systems design, technical support, rewards programs, training, project registration, and more.

### Robust Product Selection

With more than 500,000 products from over 1,000 trusted brands, ADI offers a carefully curated
selection of solutions to meet the needs for any application. We make purchasing easy - customers
can shop in-store or online and choose from multiple delivery options or in-store pickup.

[Robust Product Selection]

## ABOUT ARIHANT

Established in 1986, Arihant Appliances LLP has has managed to become a cult brand within the
domestic household sector, earning its status as one of India's leading kitchen appliances
distribution companies.
Originally focused on LPG stoves, the company has expanded its product portfolio to diverse range of
kitchen appliances, proudly serving Bharat Gas, HP Gas, and Indane Gas Dealers. Solidified its
presence as distributors for Hafele Appliances for Pune and connected districts, Wildcraft luggage
in Pune and South Maharashtra, and Tata Swatch TechJal in Maharashtra, Goa, and Chhattisgarh,
confirming the strong commitment to quoted deliverables.

Beyond the realm of kitchen appliances, Arihant Appliances LLP has ventured into the dynamic arena
of **Corporate Rental Spaces** offering tailored solutions for your business that fits your budget
and meets all your business needs. Currently, the company boasts strategically located premises in
Pune's prime real estate areas of **Market Yard and Kalyani Nagar **, exemplifying its dedication to
providing top-notch facilities for businesses.

## Iconic objects for design bathrooms

AXOR conceives and manufactures iconic objects for luxury bathrooms. Developed in collaboration with
world-renowned designers—Philippe Starck, Antonio Citterio, Jean-Marie Massaud and Barber Osgerby
among them—the [AXOR collections ][146]feature products in a wide variety of styles for the
[washbasin][147], [bathtub][148] and [shower][149]. To ensure a consistent visual language
throughout any design bathroom, AXOR also offers a comprehensive range of [bathroom
accessories][150]. In addition to [mixers][151], [showers][152] and [accessories][153], AXOR
products for design bathrooms include [thermostatic valves ][154]and [waste systems][155] featuring
advanced AXOR [concealed installation technology][156].

[An AXOR Citterio kitchen mixer in Matt Black]

## Distinctive mixers for design kitchens

AXOR [kitchen mixers][157] bring exceptional design, intuitive technology and precision engineering
to any luxury kitchen. Developed in collaboration with Philippe Starck, Antonio Citterio and Phoenix
Design, AXOR kitchen mixers ensure effortless ease of operation for all who appreciate the art of
cooking, from amateur gastronomes to professional chefs de cuisine. Available in up to 15 exclusive
[AXOR FinishPlus][158] surfaces, AXOR [kitchen mixers][159] can be personalized to suit the style of
any design kitchen.

**Hey friends,**

# We’re Drew Barrymore Cookware, A Kitchen Appliances Manufacturer

Our brand Drew Barrymore Cookware, Beautiful by Drew Barrymore, is a collaboration between the
renowned actress Drew Barrymore and kitchenware manufacturer Made by Gather, offering a stylish and
high-performing ceramic non-stick cookware.
[ Learn more ][8]

## Drew Barrymore Cooking Appliances

Combining Drew Barrymore’s iconic style with high-performance functionality, the Beautiful
Kitchenware brand offers a range of versatile and aesthetically-pleasing appliances for the modern
kitchen.

### Drew Barrymore Crockpot

The crockpot is a versatile 6-quart, 5-in-1 programmable slow cooker with low, high, and keep warm
heat settings, designed for dishes like meat, poultry, stew, and chili.

### Drew Barrymore Air Fryer

The Beautiful by Drew Barrymore 6-Quart Air Fryer is a 1,700-watt appliance with functions like Air
Fry, Roast, Reheat, and Dehydrate, available in stylish colors.

### Drew Barrymore Coffee Maker

The Beautiful Coffee Maker brews extra hot coffee without compromising flavor using a 1200-watt
system that can be programmed 24 hours in advance.

### Drew Barrymore Stand Mixer

The Beautiful 5.3QT Tilt-Head Stand Mixer has a 300-watt mixing system capable of mixing up to 9
dozen cookies, with 12 speeds and a tilt-head design.

### Drew Barrymore Toaster

The Beautiful 2-Slice Toaster has a 1800-watt extra wide self-adjusting slot design with 7 browning
settings and preset buttons.

### Drew Barrymore Slow Cooker

The Beautiful by Drew Barrymore Mini Slow Cooker Set includes two compact versatile slow cookers,
available for $15 at Walmart or Amazon.

## Drew Barrymore Cookware Bestsellers

[12pc Ceramic Non-Stick Cookware Set]

### 12pc Ceramic Non-Stick Cookware Set

The 12-piece Drew Barrymore Beautiful ceramic non-stick cookware set features a durable, sleek
design with gold die-cast handles and lids, oven-safe up to 500°F, compatible with all stovetops
including induction, and includes an 8″ fry pan, 10″ fry pan, 3qt sauté pan, 2qt saucepan, 5qt Dutch
oven, and 4 cookware protectors, all made with a non-toxic, PTFE/PFOA/PFOS-free ceramic coating.

[ Check Price ][9]

### Drew Barrymore Touchscreen Slow Cooker

The Beautiful by Drew Barrymore 6QT Programmable Touchscreen Slow Cooker is a stylish and versatile
oval-shaped appliance made of durable stainless steel, with a large 6-quart capacity for
family-sized meals, featuring an intuitive touch-activated digital display that allows you to
conveniently program cooking times and temperatures with precision for perfectly tender, flavorful
slow-cooked dishes every time.

[ Check Price ][10]

### Drew Barrymore 5 in 1 Electric Skillet

This skillet offers exceptional versatility with its adjustable 5QT to 7QT capacity, featuring a
powerful 1500-watt heating system with 5 temperature settings, a tempered glass lid with steam vent,
and a durable steel construction with a premium soft matte finish that is fully immersible and
dishwasher-safe for easy cleaning, allowing you to sauté, steam, simmer, slow cook, and serve
buffet-style all in one convenient appliance.

[ Check Price ][11]

their exceptional quality, stylish designs, and thoughtful features, as evident from:

The durable construction with gold die-cast handles and lids that can withstand oven temperatures up

Kitchenware brand offers a range of versatile and aesthetically-pleasing appliances for the modern
kitchen.

The crockpot is a versatile 6-quart, 5-in-1 programmable slow cooker with low, high, and keep warm
heat settings, designed for dishes like meat, poultry, stew, and chili.

Fry, Roast, Reheat, and Dehydrate, available in stylish colors.

system that can be programmed 24 hours in advance.

dozen cookies, with 12 speeds and a tilt-head design.

settings and preset buttons.

available for $15 at Walmart or Amazon.

##### خدمات تعمیر رایگان

بیش از 200 نمایندگی فعال در سراسر کشور، آماده ارائه خدمات تعمیر رایگان بدون نیاز به مراجعه حضوری و

##### ۲ سال گارانتی محصولات

2 سال گارانتی برای تمامی محصولات خانه و آشپزخانه ناساالکتریک با فعال‌سازی سریع از طریق پیامک یا وب‌سایت
خدمات پس از فروش

تأمین قطعات اصلی و مورد نیاز از طریق نمایندگان مجاز ناسا سرویس در سراسر کشور، همراه با امکان ثبت
سفارش آسان

## ELECTRONICS, TOYS, GAMING CONSOLES, HOME & KITCHEN APPLIANCES, CELL PHONE & ACCESSORIES, AND
## MORE.

Smarteck Distribution is a national and international wholesale distributor and closeout source. We
offer the latest and most innovative products from top manufacturers supplying by the pallet or by
the container. We supply product to a large network of retailers, e-commerce sellers, exporters, and
distributors across the globe.

 

We provide supply chain solutions, fulfillment, and logistics programs, drop-shipping,
Amazon Fulfillment (FBA), suited to meet the requirements of the
business-to-business, business-to-consumer and e-commerce markets. Product ships from FL, CA, NY,
NJ, IL, and TX distribution centers.

 

Due to our extensive supplier network and experience, Smarteck Distribution takes pride in being
able to source great product at bottom dollar for you. Buyers can purchase the latest and most
popular products at market competitive pricing.

 

With years of experience in the industry, we proudly work with retailers, manufacturers,
distributors, and resellers. We pride ourselves on conducting our business with honesty and
integrity. We strive to create consistent growth- building strong, mutually beneficial, lasting
customer relationships.

# Built-in Oven, Cooker Hob & Cooker Hood

**Trusted since 1992 · Red Dot & iF Design Award winner · Serving Klang Valley, Northern, Southern &
East Coast Malaysia**

VATTI is one of the best kitchen appliances suppliers in Malaysia. We provide modern,
energy-efficient kitchen appliances — including cooker hoods, cooker hobs, built-in ovens, combi &
steam ovens, and dishwashers — designed to elevate your cooking and lower your energy bills.

### Welcome to VATTI Malaysia

VATTI offers high-quality kitchen appliances, including built-in ovens, steam ovens, range hoods,
cooker hobs, and cooker hoods.

VATTI has experienced remarkable growth, expanding our presence throughout Malaysia. Now, we are
serving in the

Klang Valley, Northern Region, Southern Region, and East Coast.

[][99]

#### [Hardware Workshop][100]

Our in-house hardware workshop achieves a 90%+ self-sufficiency rate using advanced stamping and
deep-drawing tech. We specialize in seamless 304 stainless steel interiors, ensuring cost control
and superior structural integrity for every appliance.

[][101]

#### [Injection Molding Department][102]

Equipped with precision machines, our injection molding workshop produces high-quality plastic
components in-house. This vertical integration allows us to manage tight tolerances, minimize lead
times, and maintain strict aesthetic consistency across product lines.

[][103]

#### [Assembly Workshop][104]

With a daily capacity of 7,000 units, our assembly lines operate under ISO9001 and BSCI standards.
From mold development to final packaging, we manage the full manufacturing cycle to deliver reliable
kitchen electronics to global brands.

[][105]

#### [Laboratory][106]

Our state-of-the-art lab conducts rigorous evaluations, including life span, salt spray, and drop
tests. We ensure all products meet CE, CB, and ETL standards, verifying that every unit exceeds
global safety and durability requirements before shipment.

## yongkeng Certificate

We take safety seriously at our company. All our products, including electric kettles, toasters,
and coffee makers, are built to meet strict safety standards. With certifications

like **CE, GS, CB, ETL, and RoHS**, our appliances are fully compliant with safety regulations in
Europe, the U.S., and around the world. You can trust us to deliver products that are safe and
reliable.

# Your Trusted Source for Security, AV and Smart Living Solutions

ADI is a leading distributor and solution provider of security, AV, and smart living products
serving over 100,000 customers worldwide. We offer access to a broad portfolio of products,
including top-tier distributed brands and our own exclusive brands.

With more than three decades of industry experience, we're committed to building long-lasting
customer relationships - making us a preferred partner for professionals across the industry.

# Our Mission

### We aim to provide products, services and software that help keep our communities safe, secure,
### comfortable and connected.

## Here's How We Do It

### Access to Exclusive Brands

We take pride in our exclusive, in-house manufactured products and software solutions, delivering
smart solutions that combine quality and innovation. From home automation to commercial-grade
infrastructure, we craft technologies that focus on what customers value most – delivering a
reliable and exceptional experience

[Access to Exclusive Brands]
[Support and Services]

### Support and Services

We offer a wide range of support and services to provide expert guidance at every step - from design
and configuration to ongoing support. With OvrC Remote Management, customers can easily manage,
configure, and troubleshoot devices across the network. OvrC is available on a range of exclusive
brand products and integrates with many leading distributed brands. Additional offerings include
systems design, technical support, rewards programs, training, project registration, and more.

### Robust Product Selection

With more than 500,000 products from over 1,000 trusted brands, ADI offers a carefully curated
selection of solutions to meet the needs for any application. We make purchasing easy - customers
can shop in-store or online and choose from multiple delivery options or in-store pickup.

[Robust Product Selection]

of **Corporate Rental Spaces** offering tailored solutions for your business that fits your budget

## ABOUT ARIHANT

Established in 1986, Arihant Appliances LLP has has managed to become a cult brand within the
domestic household sector, earning its status as one of India's leading kitchen appliances
distribution companies.
Originally focused on LPG stoves, the company has expanded its product portfolio to diverse range of
kitchen appliances, proudly serving Bharat Gas, HP Gas, and Indane Gas Dealers. Solidified its
presence as distributors for Hafele Appliances for Pune and connected districts, Wildcraft luggage
in Pune and South Maharashtra, and Tata Swatch TechJal in Maharashtra, Goa, and Chhattisgarh,
confirming the strong commitment to quoted deliverables.

Beyond the realm of kitchen appliances, Arihant Appliances LLP has ventured into the dynamic arena
of **Corporate Rental Spaces** offering tailored solutions for your business that fits your budget
and meets all your business needs. Currently, the company boasts strategically located premises in
Pune's prime real estate areas of **Market Yard and Kalyani Nagar **, exemplifying its dedication to
providing top-notch facilities for businesses.

## Iconic objects for design bathrooms

AXOR conceives and manufactures iconic objects for luxury bathrooms. Developed in collaboration with
world-renowned designers—Philippe Starck, Antonio Citterio, Jean-Marie Massaud and Barber Osgerby
among them—the [AXOR collections ][146]feature products in a wide variety of styles for the
[washbasin][147], [bathtub][148] and [shower][149]. To ensure a consistent visual language
throughout any design bathroom, AXOR also offers a comprehensive range of [bathroom
accessories][150]. In addition to [mixers][151], [showers][152] and [accessories][153], AXOR
products for design bathrooms include [thermostatic valves ][154]and [waste systems][155] featuring
advanced AXOR [concealed installation technology][156].

## Distinctive mixers for design kitchens

AXOR [kitchen mixers][157] bring exceptional design, intuitive technology and precision engineering
to any luxury kitchen. Developed in collaboration with Philippe Starck, Antonio Citterio and Phoenix
Design, AXOR kitchen mixers ensure effortless ease of operation for all who appreciate the art of
cooking, from amateur gastronomes to professional chefs de cuisine. Available in up to 15 exclusive
[AXOR FinishPlus][158] surfaces, AXOR [kitchen mixers][159] can be personalized to suit the style of
any design kitchen.

growing your business.

2 سال گارانتی برای تمامی محصولات خانه و آشپزخانه ناساالکتریک با فعال‌سازی سریع از طریق پیامک یا وب‌سایت
خدمات پس از فروش

تأمین قطعات اصلی و مورد نیاز از طریق نمایندگان مجاز ناسا سرویس در سراسر کشور، همراه با امکان ثبت
سفارش آسان

With modern advanced production technology,we have more than 20 years of **OEM and ODM

[][99]

#### [Hardware Workshop][100]

Our in-house hardware workshop achieves a 90%+ self-sufficiency rate using advanced stamping and
deep-drawing tech. We specialize in seamless 304 stainless steel interiors, ensuring cost control
and superior structural integrity for every appliance.

[][101]

#### [Injection Molding Department][102]

Equipped with precision machines, our injection molding workshop produces high-quality plastic
components in-house. This vertical integration allows us to manage tight tolerances, minimize lead
times, and maintain strict aesthetic consistency across product lines.

[][103]

#### [Assembly Workshop][104]

With a daily capacity of 7,000 units, our assembly lines operate under ISO9001 and BSCI standards.
From mold development to final packaging, we manage the full manufacturing cycle to deliver reliable
kitchen electronics to global brands.

[][105]

#### [Laboratory][106]

Our state-of-the-art lab conducts rigorous evaluations, including life span, salt spray, and drop
tests. We ensure all products meet CE, CB, and ETL standards, verifying that every unit exceeds
global safety and durability requirements before shipment.
